title: Capabilities, robot specs and site infrastructure
description: Robots are defined by what they can do, not by type. Each capability has a fixed work unit: scan m2, dig m3, grade m2, haul kg, compact m2, sinter m2, repair health-fraction, charge Wh, relay m (coverage radius, no rate). Also defines the fixed site infrastructure: charge stations, depots, the power system and the comms base station.

rate.description: Work units per second (0 for relay).

capacity.description: Maximum units held at once: haul payload kg, charge stored Wh.

range_m.description: Effective radius: scan footprint, relay coverage.

RobotSpec.description: Static advertisement of a robot, sent once at the start of a run.

ChargeStation.description: Fixed charging point connected to the site power grid.

Depot.description: Maintenance depot. A robot on the depot's cell can be serviced there with the `service` command, which clears every fault and resets wear.

PowerMode.description: Power architecture of the site. hybrid: fission baseline plus solar and storage (the default). solar_only: solar and storage only. nuclear_heavy: mostly fission.

PowerSystem.description: The site power grid. Supply is fission plus solar (clear-sky peak scaled by the day curve and dust transmittance). Demand is the essential load plus station charging. Surplus fills storage up to capacity and deficits are drawn from it.

solar_peak_w.description: Solar output at noon under a clear sky.

storage_capacity_wh.description: Capacity of the site battery bank.

essential_load_w.description: Always-on site load, served before any charging.

BaseStation.description: The site comms hub. A robot is in coverage within `range_m` of it, or within range of an active relay that is itself in coverage.

range_m.description: Direct coverage radius in metres, measured between cell centres.
